literal: Justice having done who protects king, to the people god saying to be placed will be.
translation: A king who administers justice and protects his subjects will be considered a god to his people.
modern: நீதியுடன் ஆட்சி செய்து மக்களைக் காப்பாற்றும் மன்னவன், மக்களுக்கு ஒரு தெய்வமாகவே கருதப்படுவான்.
explanation: This couplet defines the highest standard for a ruler. The phrase 'முறை செய்து' means administering justice properly and maintaining order. When a king combines this strict justice with the active protection of his subjects, he elevates his status. Because of these divine qualities of justice and protection, the people will look up to him and consider him a god.
